lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: After two years of peaceful protests, Serbia’s student movement won a historic snap election.

lines.speaker: everyman_ivan
lines.text: Wait—students actually won the *government*? Seriously?

lines.speaker: mayor_mila
lines.text: They did! But now comes the gritty business of governing.

lines.text: The Upset.

scenes.narration: The Upset.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It all started after a station canopy collapsed in Novi Sad, killing 16 people.

lines.speaker: mayor_mila
lines.text: So students blockaded faculties demanding *accountability*?

lines.speaker: economist_bora
lines.text: Exactly. They expanded demands to corruption and weak institutions.

lines.text: No politicians? Just *professors* and doctors?
